# Draft:Foreign-Born Population of the Czech Republic

Czech Republic (or Czechia) has, as of 31st December 2023, 1,065,740 immigrants according to the Czech Statistical Office. The Migration Policy Institute (which sources from United Nations data) however claims there are 1,025,000 immigrants in the country as of mid-2024. As of 2025, 10% of new-borns have at least 1 foreign-born parent, mainly from Ukraine, Slovakia and Vietnam. This is also reflected in adults, with 10% being born outside the Czech Republic, with a significant rise in the population due to the Russia-Ukraine war and subsequent emigration. Below is a table of statistics regarding the origins of said immigrants. Any countries that aren't mentioned have no data.
